repo.description:
### Summary
A hardcoded credential in the provided installation script (located at https://dokploy.com/install.sh, line 154) uses a hardcoded password when creating the database container. This means that nearly all Dokploy installations use the same database credentials and could be compromised.

### Details
If an attacker gains access to the internal dokploy-network via code execution/SSRF on the web app or a vulnerable application (all apps with domains connected are in this network), they could connect to the database using the credentials found and manipulate information. A solution to this would be using a random password that's generated on run using `openssl` and kept in an environment variable.

### PoC
- User installs Dokploy via installation script.
- Attacker gains access to database using the hardcoded credentials found in the installation script. 
- Attacker can then access sensitive information.

### Impact
Anyone who has installed Dokploy using this script in it's current version is affected.
repo.summary: Use of hardcoded credentials in installation script could result in database access
